name: BloodBowl_Card
cardText:
Claws, Frenzy, Loner (4+), 
Might Blow, Prehensile Tail, 
Thick Skull, Unchannelled Fury
specialRules: Fury of the Blood God: Once per game, if Scyla rolls a 1 for his Unchannelled Fury roll after declaring a Block Action then, instead of applying the usual effects of Unchanneled Fury, Scyla may perform two Block Actions instead. The first Block Action must be fully resolved, including the use of the Frenzy Skill, before the second one is performed.
